NE.EXP.GNFS.ZS_rate_percentage_trade_mul.definition: Exports of goods and services (% of GDP)
NE.EXP.GNFS.ZS_rate_percentage_trade_mul.reason: existing Mature trade family, percentage/rate unit, fractional likely non-monotonic values, multiple entities, and dispersion has clearer bounded-window descriptive meaning.

NY.GDP.PCAP.KD_second_dnk_indicator.reason: more substantive than population, but still level series and may invite growth/trend interpretations.

SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS_missingness_candidate.definition: Government expenditure on education, total (% of GDP)
SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS_missingness_candidate.reason: good missingness test candidate but likely higher missingness may obscure v2 method replication with evidence availability questions.

SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS_fractional_rate_candidate.definition: Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate)
SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS_fractional_rate_candidate.family: social/labor WDI; not yet selected as existing Mature family here
SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS_fractional_rate_candidate.reason: fractional rate and dispersion are meaningful, but modeled estimates and family maturity fit are weaker than trade exports share.

SP.POP.TOTL_multi_entity_population_leve.reason: mechanically easy but repeats Campaign 34 level-series weakness; raw population means across countries add low reusable value.
